title: END FENTANYL Act
official_summary:
Eradicating Narcotic Drugs and Formulating Effective New Tools to Address National Yearly Losses of life Act or the END FENTANYL Act

This act requires U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to review and update certain manuals and policies related to inspections at ports of entry at least once every three years. Specifically, CPB’s review and updates must ensure inspection practices effectively respond to technological and methodological changes designed to disguise illegal activity along the border, such as the smuggling of drugs and humans.

The act also requires that CPB provide the Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs and the House Committee on Homeland Security with a report summarizing the changes made by such an update.

summary.headline: Requires Customs and Border Protection to review and update its port-of-entry inspection manuals at least every three years.
summary.what_it_does: This law requires U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to review and update certain manuals and policies for inspections at ports of entry at least once every three years. The updates must make sure inspection practices keep up with new technology and methods used to hide illegal activity at the border, such as smuggling drugs or people. CBP must send a report summarizing the changes to the homeland security committees in the Senate and House.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers and staff
who_it_affects.how: Their inspection manuals and policies at ports of entry must be reviewed and updated at least every three years.

who_it_affects.group: Travelers and shippers crossing at U.S. ports of entry
who_it_affects.how: The inspection practices they go through may change as CBP updates its rules to respond to new smuggling methods.
They will receive reports from CBP summarizing the changes made in each update.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 18, 2024; reviews and updates are required at least once every three years.
